name: persistent-worker-runtime
description: Use the persistent-worker-runtime library to offload CPU-bound work to persistent Node.js worker threads while keeping the Event Loop responsive. Covers pool setup, request-response vs outbox modes, L1 state, cancellation, priority routing, zero-copy transfer, retries, preemption, inter-worker BroadcastChannel for L1 cache invalidation, durable queue via node:sqlite (SqliteTaskQueue with lease-based orphan recovery + retry budget), and liveness/readiness probes (runtime.isAlive() + runtime.isReady()) for k8s/LB/cron transport wiring.
author: Felipe Miiller
triggers: execute a task on a worker
